items.statement: Barrier for closure onto the benzyl-tethered aryl ring
items.expected: Identify the benzyl-tethered aryl closure by connectivity and forming-bond/negative-mode evidence, corresponding to source TS2. Compute G(TS)-G(uncyclized radical minimum), 298.15 K/1 atm, implicit DMSO, charge0 doublet. Validate the minimum and relevant first-order saddle; source -0.05 is on a different plot zero and is not this barrier.

items.statement: Barrier for closure onto the arenesulfonyl aryl ring
items.expected: Identify the arenesulfonyl aryl closure by connectivity and forming-bond/negative-mode evidence, corresponding to source TS2-prime. Use the same radical-reference definition and valid saddle evidence. Arbitrary candidate numbers or closest energies do not determine identity.
